1660 is a leap year (divisible by 4 and not a century exception).  
06-17-1660 minus 49 weeks = 49 × 7 = 343 days.  
Plus 3 more days = 346 days before 06-17-1660.  

Count back:  
June 17 → June 1 is 16 days back (June: 30 days, so June 17 to June 1 = 16 days earlier in June).  
346 − 16 = 330 days left to go back into 1659.  

From June 1, 1660 back to Jan 1, 1660:  
Jan (31) + Feb (29, leap) + Mar (31) + Apr (30) + May (31) = 152 days.  
330 − 152 = 178 days left in 1659.  

1659 is not leap (not divisible by 4).  
Back from Dec 31, 1659:  
Dec (31) + Nov (30) + Oct (31) + Sep (30) + Aug (31) + Jul (31) = 184 days from Jul 1 to Dec 31.  
We need 178 days before Dec 31, 1659: 184 − 178 = 6 days into July 1659.  
July has 31 days, so July 31 − 6 days = July 25.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1659-07-25
